What to understand at MT7

Wave Persistence
Helps retain accumulated Wave Momentum progress, according to the software reference.
Wave Catalyst
Uses Critical Wavejump activity to support acceleration. Its value depends on having a useful prior record.
Era
The next scale of tower testing, reached at the 100-billion-wave boundary. Its combat systems are explained in the MT8 guide; you do not need to master them for this push.

What you are working toward

  • Work toward wave 100,000,000,000 and confirm the promotion conditions in Headquarters.
  • Complete the current module collection and total-tier objectives alongside the wave push.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an suggested route based on community strategies. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Research the MT7 acceleration tools

    Inspect Wave Persistence, Instability, Vortex, Catalyst and Endurance. Read each current tooltip and enable the tools that support your intended run. The community references describes Persistence as supporting Momentum retention, Instability as improving Wavejump, and Vortex/Endurance as improving streaming speed. [S07]

  2. Build a wider base of normal clears

    Work through more of the 15 regions and six normal difficulties, up to 90 combinations where practical. This is useful support for Wave Storm, not a separate claim that all 90 are mandatory for promotion. [S07] [S12]

  3. Establish a meaningful Endless record

    Critical Wavejump is more useful when there is a substantial record to jump toward. Use your reliable combat build to push, then compare how much faster you revisit that territory on a later run. Do not restart constantly without understanding what progress your software retains. [S07]

  4. Keep kills and survival steady

    Continue improving a high-kill-rate blueprint and permanent bonuses from your available buildings. When enemies already die quickly, focus on acceleration and uptime instead of repeatedly buying damage that does not change the run. [S12] [S06]

  5. Let the acceleration develop

    Allow a stable run time to gain the benefit of streaming and acceleration software. Older community routes include specific restart timing; treat those as experiments, not guaranteed instructions for your version. Compare actual time to a repeatable milestone. [S12] [S07]

If you are stuck

I am stuck near my old million-wave record

Check Momentum, Storm and Persistence before buying more attack. Also verify that you are in the intended Endless mode.

Following an old timer makes my run worse

Software behavior has changed across versions. Use the current descriptions and your measured progress rather than a fixed historical timer.

Ready to move on?

  • The 100-billion-wave milestone and remaining Headquarters objectives are complete.
  • After promotion, inspect the Era Workshop and newly available software.
After the promotion

At MT8, enemies gain Era mechanics. Ordinary damage upgrades alone will no longer explain whether a blueprint succeeds. [S02] [S07]
